title: 初入电波世界
title_en: Entering the world of ham radio for the first time
content: 在我上小学时，社交媒体向我推送了一条又一条关于业余无线电的视频，也是从这时，我的业余无线电之路正式埋下了一颗种子，在搜索了大量攻略后，我尝试了一下模拟测试，但是一直考不过，于是这粒种子进入了休眠期。14岁这年，刷社交媒体时又一次动容了我考证的念头，在备考群聊中认识到了一位威海的的爱好者，于是我们约定一起考试，在威海度过了10天的美好的时光后，我在6月28日把A类操作证考下来了，此刻这颗种子已生根发芽。不久，在7月3日，我的呼号也顺利获批——BG4LZN。
content_en: When I was in primary school, social media kept sending me one video after another about amateur radio. It was at this time that a seed was planted on my path of amateur radio. After searching through a large number of guides, I attempted a simulation test, but I kept failing. So this seed went into a dormant state. At the age of 14, when browsing social media again, my desire to take the exam was once again aroused. In the study group chat, I met an enthusiast from Weihai. So we agreed to take the exam together. After spending 10 wonderful days in Weihai, on June 28th, I passed the A-class operation certificate. At this moment, this seed had taken root and sprouted. Soon, on July 3rd, my call sign was successfully approved - BG4LZN.

title: Hello,AC3RD!
content: 在获得我的中国业余无线电呼号的365天后，我顺利的拿到了美国的呼号——AC3RD，本次考试我选择了由Debi女士领导的KJ7QZJ考试小组，通过线上完成了考试。考试的时候我正值15岁，在考试小组对青少年的特殊政策下，我免费获得了我的CSCE和执照，非常感谢KJ7QZJ考试小组的VE们向我提供的帮助，让我在业余无线电之路获得新的里程碑。
content_en: After 365 days of obtaining my amateur radio call sign in China, I successfully obtained the US call sign - AC3RD. For this exam, I chose the KJ7QZJ examination team led by Ms. Debi and completed the exam online. During the exam, I was 15 years old. Under the special policy for teenagers by the examination team, I received my CSCE and license for free. I am very grateful to the VE members of KJ7QZJ examination team for the help they provided to me, which has given me a new milestone on the path of amateur radio.

title: 步入高频！
content: 2026年4月6日，我与本地ham朋友，在泰安市无线电科普中心，考取了B类业余无线电操作能力验证证书，从此获得了中国大陆全业余波段发射权限。
content_en: On April 6, 2026, together with my local ham friends, at the Radio Science Popularization Center in Tai'an City, we obtained the B-Class Amateur Radio Operating Ability Verification Certificate. Since then, we have acquired the permission to transmit on all amateur bands in the Chinese mainland.
